brief.text: Pharmaceutical and healthcare issuers dominate the highest-value activity, led by RAPP where seven insiders generated a cluster total of $22.02 million—the largest dollar amount and participant count in the group. UPBD also stands out for broad cluster activity with six insiders totaling $1.29 million. Outside of cluster purchases, ASPE registered the largest single commitments via matching $15.0 million transactions from Peter A. Thompson and OrbiMed Advisors LLC, followed by a $12.92 million transaction in DOLE by Pale Fire Capital.
